name: Wikidata
notes: Ownership, country, inception, legal form, website, Wikipedia link. Facts with citations; unrestricted reuse. Imported by `ledger import wikidata`.

name: Wikipedia: Reliable sources/Perennial sources
notes: English Wikipedia editors' consensus on source reliability, each verdict linked to its discussions. Attribution and share-alike required: every claim links its row and carries a bounded copy of the summary. Imported by `ledger import wikipedia_rsp`; run the Wikidata import first so rows match by article.

name: Domain registry (RDAP)
notes: Registration date, last change, registrar and status for each of the outlet's registrable domains, from the registry's own RDAP server via the rdap.org redirector. Public registration data; each claim links the registry record. Imported by `ledger import rdap`.

name: First Report feed (observed behaviour)
notes: Measured by First Report from feed's export over a rolling window: posting cadence, revision and withdrawal rates, syndication share, origin share. Each claim carries the window and the counts it was computed from; outlets with fewer than 10 items in the window get no claim. A measurement, not a verdict: a wire service is meant to be copied. Imported by `ledger import feed_behaviour --feed-export <dir>`.
